test.title: An island that makes its own power

paragraphs.text: For most of the twentieth century, the island of Keldon depended on a single cable from the mainland for its electricity. When storms damaged the cable, as they did several times a decade, the island’s 400 residents could be without power for days.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: In 2012 a community group proposed building three wind turbines and owning them jointly. Banks were reluctant to lend money to a group with no experience, so the project was paid for partly by a government grant and partly by residents, who bought shares for as little as £50 each.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: The turbines now produce more electricity than the island uses. The surplus is sold to the mainland through the same cable that once brought power in, and the income, around £120,000 in a good year, is shared between the shareholders and a fund for local projects.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: The fund has paid for insulation in older houses, a new roof for the village hall and an electric minibus that takes elderly residents to the doctor. Not all islanders were enthusiastic at first: some objected to the noise and the view, and two turbines were moved further from homes after complaints.
paragraphs.label: D

document.title: An island that makes its own power

items.quote: When storms damaged the cable, as they did several times a decade, the island’s 400 residents could be without power for days
items.prompt: Before the turbines were built, the island’s electricity supply was

options.text: cheap but limited.
produced by diesel generators.
sometimes cut off by bad weather.
shared with a neighbouring island.

explanation.en: “When storms damaged the cable … residents could be without power for days” → C: “cut off by bad weather” = “storms … without power”. Price (A), generators (B) and another island (D) are not mentioned.
explanation.kk: «When storms damaged the cable … residents could be without power for days» → C: «cut off by bad weather» = «storms … without power». Баға (A), генератор (B) және көрші арал (D) туралы мәтінде ештеңе жоқ.
explanation.ru: «When storms damaged the cable … residents could be without power for days» → C: «cut off by bad weather» = «storms … without power». Про цену (A), генераторы (B) и соседний остров (D) в тексте нет.

items.quote: Banks were reluctant to lend money to a group with no experience
items.prompt: The project was not paid for mainly by a bank loan because

options.text: the group had no experience.
interest rates were too high.
the government did not allow it.
residents did not want any debt.

explanation.en: “Banks were reluctant to lend money to a group with no experience” → A. The government (C) did not forbid it but gave a grant; interest rates (B) and residents’ attitude to debt (D) are not mentioned.
explanation.kk: «Banks were reluctant to lend money to a group with no experience» → A. Үкімет (C) жобаға тыйым салмаған, керісінше грант берген; пайыз (B) пен тұрғындардың қарызға көзқарасы (D) айтылмаған.
explanation.ru: «Banks were reluctant to lend money to a group with no experience» → A. Правительство (C) проект не запрещало, а дало грант; о ставках (B) и отношении жителей к долгам (D) не сказано.

items.quote: residents, who bought shares for as little as £50 each
items.prompt: Residents who wanted to invest in the turbines

options.text: had to pay at least £500.
could buy shares for a small amount.
were given shares free of charge.
needed permission from the council.

explanation.en: “bought shares for as little as £50 each” → B. Option A distorts the figure (£500 instead of £50), and shares were not free (C).
explanation.kk: «bought shares for as little as £50 each» → B. A нұсқасы санды бұрмалайды (£50 орнына £500), тегін акция (C) болмаған.
explanation.ru: «bought shares for as little as £50 each» → B. Вариант A искажает цифру (£500 вместо £50), бесплатных акций (C) не было.

items.quote: The surplus is sold to the mainland through the same cable that once brought power in
items.prompt: What happens to electricity that the island does not use?

options.text: It is stored in large batteries.
It is given to the mainland free of charge.
It is sold through the old cable.
It is used to charge the minibus.

explanation.en: “The surplus is sold to the mainland through the same cable” → C. It is sold, not given away (B). The minibus (D) was bought with fund money; charging it is not mentioned.
explanation.kk: «The surplus is sold to the mainland through the same cable» → C. Электр тегін берілмейді (B), сатылады. Шағын автобус (D) қордың табысына алынған, оны зарядтау туралы айтылмаған.
explanation.ru: «The surplus is sold to the mainland through the same cable» → C. Электричество продают, а не отдают даром (B). Минибус (D) купили на доход фонда, о его зарядке ничего не сказано.

items.quote: two turbines were moved further from homes after complaints
items.prompt: Complaints from some islanders led to

options.text: one turbine being removed.
two turbines being moved further from homes.
the turbines being made quieter.
the project being stopped for a year.

explanation.en: “two turbines were moved further from homes after complaints” → B. They were moved, not removed (A); making them quieter (C) or stopping the project (D) is not mentioned.
explanation.kk: «two turbines were moved further from homes after complaints» → B. Турбиналар алынып тасталмаған (A), басқа жерге жылжытылған; шуды азайту (C) мен жобаны тоқтату (D) айтылмаған.
explanation.ru: «two turbines were moved further from homes after complaints» → B. Турбины перенесли, а не убрали (A); о снижении шума (C) и остановке проекта (D) не сказано.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–5. Choose the correct letter, A, B, C or D.
